test_cases.title: Customer can update their details with valid contact information
acs: DERIVED: Edit Customer/Invoice details is reachable and the form accepts valid contact data - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/EditCustomerDetails.aspx:11-217
assumptions: The signed-in user has an existing customer record and can access the edit screen.
A valid login is available for the external web user role.

steps.action: Open the Edit Customer/Invoice details page for the signed-in customer.
steps.expected: The page heading is Edit Customer/Invoice details and the customer and invoice form fields are visible.

steps.action: Fill the required customer fields with valid values for contact name, organisation, address, telephone and email.
steps.expected: The entered values match the expected values and no validation warning is shown for the required customer fields.

steps.action: Fill the required invoice details with valid values for organisation, address and email.
steps.expected: The invoice section accepts the values and shows no validation warning for the required invoice fields.

steps.action: Submit the updated details by selecting UPDATE DETAILS.
steps.expected: The page submits without a client-side validation error and the update request is sent.
The customer detail update is confirmed and the user can continue without being blocked by validation errors.

test_cases.title: Customer is blocked from saving when required contact details are empty
acs: DERIVED: Required field validation is enforced for customer details on the edit form - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/EditCustomerDetails.aspx:30-108
assumptions: The customer form can be submitted with an incomplete record to trigger validation.
The exact validation message text is confirmed by the UI once the page is loaded under the real session.

steps.action: Open the Edit Customer/Invoice details page for the signed-in customer.
steps.expected: The form is loaded and the required field controls are visible.

steps.action: Clear the Contact Name, Organisation name, Address line 1, Address line 2, Telephone and Email fields.
steps.expected: The fields are empty and the form is ready to validate.

steps.action: Attempt to update the customer details.
steps.expected: The page stops the save and shows the required-field validation messages for the empty customer data.

steps.action: Check the form state after the validation failure.
steps.expected: The required fields remain highlighted and the update is not persisted.

steps.action: Change the Contact Name field to a value and resubmit.
steps.expected: The validation error clears only for the Contact Name field and the remaining required fields remain enforced.

test_cases.title: Customer cannot submit an order until terms and required consent declarations are accepted
acs: DERIVED: The order wizard cannot move past its first step until a scheme with a distribution month is selected, and SUBMIT stays disabled until the terms and every consent declaration are accepted (PendingContractOrder.aspx.vb NextButtonEnabled, BtnSubmit)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user. The database has a backup.
Cleanup: the test deselects the scheme it selected. The order is never submitted.
Consent declarations appear only for some schemes; the test checks that SUBMIT stays disabled until the terms are accepted (TC-113 covers enabling).

steps.expected: The Create New Order page opens.

steps.action: Tick the last scheme that has a month available to order.
steps.expected: The scheme is ticked and its months are ticked.
The Pending Order summary is shown.

steps.action: Leave the terms and conditions unticked.
